name: Skeuomorphism
summary: Interfaces that copy real objects: leather, linen, wood, felt, glass and brushed metal, lit from above with gradients and layered shadows. It has roots in 1980s desktop icons and peaked in iOS 1 to 6, until iOS 7 replaced it in 2013.

philosophy.core_thesis: A screen control is easier to learn when it looks and behaves like a physical object that the user already knows.
design_principles: Model each control on a real object with a known use, such as a toggle switch, a notepad, a bookshelf or a dial, and keep its proportions within 10% of the original.
Light every surface from the top with one light source at 90 degrees, so that highlights sit on the top edge and shadows fall down.
Build depth from 3 to 5 stacked layers: a 1px light top highlight, a 2 to 4 gradient body, a 1px dark bottom edge, an inner shadow and an outer drop shadow.
Texture large surfaces with a repeating bitmap of 128 to 256px at 4 to 12% opacity: linen, leather, paper, wood grain or felt.
Give every button a gradient of 8 to 15% lightness difference from top to bottom, and invert that gradient while the button is pressed.
Add one stitched, embossed or debossed detail on each material panel, with a 1px inner highlight and a 1px outer shadow.
Reflect the real world in motion: page curls, flip transitions and spring-loaded switches follow the physics of the object they imitate.
anti_patterns: Flat solid fills with no gradient or shadow on controls
A light source that changes direction between components
Textures that tile with a visible seam or repeat period shorter than 64px
Material metaphors that do not match the function, such as a wooden calculator
Hairline 1px outline icons with no fill
Shadows with a blur radius of 0px and no spread
Pure white backgrounds with no surface texture

layout.grid_mechanics: A 320 by 480pt canvas on iPhone, later 320 by 568pt, with a 44pt minimum touch target; content sits in full-width grouped rows or on shelves with a 10 to 20pt margin.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 20–35% of the surface stays empty because textures and frames fill the rest; the spacing scale is 4, 10, 20, 44pt.
layout.alignment_rules: Controls sit inside the frame of their object metaphor, such as rows in a table, books on a shelf or pages in a notebook; text is centred on buttons and flush left in rows.
layout.container_geometry: Rounded rectangles with a 5 to 10px radius, grouped table cells with a 10px radius on the outer corners, and 44px high bars with a 1px bevel.

font_pairings.note: A slab for object labels with a humanist text face, close to the Marker Felt and Helvetica mix of iOS 6 notes.
A slab for leather and wood panels with a rounded sans for legible controls.
A handwriting face for notepad and journal metaphors, with a neutral sans for UI text.

typography.tracking: Display sizes sit at 0em to 0.01em; body stays at 0; button labels take +0.02em.
typography.leading: Display 1.1; body 1.3 to 1.4; table rows hold a 44px height with a single 17px line.
hierarchy_rules: Use bold (700) for button and title labels and regular (400) for body text.
Set 17px for titles and rows, 14px for secondary labels and 12px for captions.
Add a 1px text shadow, white at 60% opacity below dark text or black at 60% opacity above light text, so the text looks stamped into the surface.
Set title text in a different face on object-bound screens, such as a slab on a bookshelf or a script on a notepad.

color.palette_structure: Three to five material colours with 60% of the surface in the dominant material, plus a glossy blue accent for primary controls on 10 to 15% of the surface.
color.contrast_rules: Text on material surfaces holds at least 4.5:1; light text on leather brown and felt green reaches about 8:1, and text on glossy blue reaches 4.5:1.
color.surface_treatment: Photographic textures, linear gradients with a 50% hard split for gloss, and noise at 3 to 6% opacity; glass uses a white 30% highlight over the upper half.
color.light_and_shadow: One light source from the top; highlights are white at 40 to 70% opacity on top edges, shadows are black at 25 to 50% opacity pointing down with a 1 to 3px offset.

materiality.surface_simulation: Real materials: leather with stitching, linen, paper, wood, felt, brushed aluminium, glass and chrome.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px dark outer edge at 40 to 60% black, a 1px white inner highlight at 40 to 60% opacity, and dashed 1px stitching inset 4px from the edge on leather.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Drop shadows with 0 1px 2px at 40% black for buttons and 0 4px 10px at 50% black for panels; inner shadows of inset 0 1px 3px at 50% black for wells; elevation uses 3 levels.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Glossy filled icons of 57 by 57px with a 12px radius, a top gloss highlight over 50% of the height, a 1px bevel and a reflected shadow below.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Rendered object illustrations with lighting, such as bookshelves, microphones, film reels and tape decks, drawn from a 3/4 top view.

motion.transition_physics: Object physics: pages curl and flip over 400 to 600ms, switches slide with a 20ms spring settle and shelves scroll with inertia and 8px of edge bounce.
motion.hover_and_active: Pressed state inverts the button gradient and removes the outer shadow, so the button looks pushed 1 to 2px into the surface; touch devices have no hover.

emotion.target_response: Familiarity and tactile comfort: the user feels that the app is an object that can be picked up and used without instruction.

use_cases: games with a table or board
avoid_when: The product is data-dense and every pixel of chrome costs reading space.
The brand must feel abstract, minimal or software-native.
The design must scale across many densities and run on low-power devices where 5 shadow layers cost frame rate.

modifiers.how: Remove all gradients, textures and shadows, set solid fills, and keep the colours and 5 to 10px radius of the original.
Replace textures with solid surfaces, use 1 to 24dp elevation shadows with a top-left key light, and keep the paper metaphor.
Replace material textures with aqua gradients and glass highlights, add bokeh nature imagery, and keep the top light source.
Swap natural materials for chrome, translucent plastic and cyan with 24px blur glows; keep the bevels and the gloss.
